{"metadata":{"description":"dsh预设热切换","id":"gh:1337232110","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-preset-switcher","slug":"jeffcwj/dsh-preset-switcher","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"# dsh-preset-switcher"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"> English | **中文**"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"## 概述"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"DSH Web 插件：在**任何时候**切换当前会话的代理预设（模式），包括对话已经开始之后 — 原生 UI 不允许这样做（"已开始的对话的代理预设已固定"）。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"### 核心功能"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **顶部下拉菜单**：会话标题操作栏中的「当前模式 ▾」按钮，列出所有预设（如 `standard`=标准模式、`code`=PTC 模式、`minimal`=极简模式、`cordis`=创造模式"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"），用 ✓ 标记当前预设，点击即切换。
- **失效预设修复**：如果会话记录的预设已被删除（自定义预设被移除），恢复将失败导致会话不可用。下拉菜单中的「修复失效模式会话」操作（及 `repair` "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"API）会扫描所有会话日志，向引用失效的会话**追加**一条指向默认预设的 `agent-preset/selected` 事件（只追加、不改写；恢复时最后一个事件生效），并跳过活跃会话。
- **未"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"打开的会话也能切（自动载入）**：会话若只是「本进程还没载入」，插件先走宿主会话控制器的 `resolveAgent()`（`/api/session/*` 用的同一条 resolve-or-resu"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"me 路径）把它载入，再就地重组；只有载入失败（归档、不可读、写所有权在别的实例）时才退回写句柄追加延迟事件，下次打开时生效。
- **受控路由**：`POST /preset-switch/api`"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"，参数 `{ method: 'list' | 'switch' | 'repair', sessionId, presetId, target? }`（connection 信任围栏，与 dsh-s"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"hod: 'list' | 'switch' | 'repair', sessionId, presetId, target? }`（connection 信任围栏，与 dsh-sounds 相同）。"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### 工作原理"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"原生 API（`agentPresets.select`）通过空白会话检查来保护切换操作。本插件底层调用同一原子原语 — `agentPresets.recompose(agent.ctx, pres"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"etId)` — 将代理的作用域重新链接到目标预设的常驻挂载点。新组合在链接移动前确保完成，因此损坏的预设不会影响会话。成功后插件追加与代理记录相同的 `agent-preset/selected` "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"链接到目标预设的常驻挂载点。新组合在链接移动前确保完成，因此损坏的预设不会影响会话。成功后插件追加与代理记录相同的 `agent-preset/selected` 会话事件，使投影和标题标签同步更新。"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"未加载的会话没有可重组的 agent，插件改用官方 `sessionPersistence` 句柄 API（`open(id,'write')` → `append` → `flush`）把选择记录进"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"日志；恢复会话时按最后一个 `agent-preset/selected` 事件组合，所以重新打开即生效。读操作始终用 `open(id,'read')`，不会抢占活跃会话的写所有权。"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**生效时机**：切换是就地重组，**不需要重启 DSH**；新的工具集/人设从**下一个模型步骤**开始生效（已经发出的那一步仍用旧工具集）。子代理拥有的会话会被拒绝（403）。"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## 兼容性"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"面向 **DSH 0.2.x**（已在 0.2.2-alpha.2 上适配）："},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- 宿主端用 `connection` 服务的 `requestRejection()` 做信任围栏（0.1.x 的 `webRuntime` 已不存在）；
- 会话读写用 `sessionPersi"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"stence.open()`/`stat()`/`list()`（旧的 `inspect()`/`append()` 已移除）；
- 未载入会话的切换走 `sessionController.reso"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"lveAgent()`（宿主会话控制器的 resolve-or-resume 入口）；
- 客户端 bundle 未变，继续使用 `conversation.session.header.action"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"nt()`（宿主会话控制器的 resolve-or-resume 入口）；
- 客户端 bundle 未变，继续使用 `conversation.session.header.actions` 插槽。"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## 安装 / 更新"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"装完重启 dsh web（profile 启动时才会合并 `cordis.patch.yml`）。"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"> `--profile` 换成你自己的 profile 名（对应 `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>`），安装路径换成你自己的克隆位置。"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Overview"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"DSH web plugin: switch the current session's agent preset (mode) at **any time**, including after th"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"e conversation has already started — the stock UI refuses that ("a started conversation's agent pres"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" has already started — the stock UI refuses that ("a started conversation's agent preset is fixed")."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Features"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Header dropdown**: a "当前模式 ▾" button in the session header action row lists every preset (e.g. `"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"standard`=标准模式, `code`=PTC 模式, `minimal`=极简模式, `cordis`=创造模式), marks the session's current one with "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"✓, and switches on click.
- **Stale-preset repair**: if a session's recorded preset was deleted (a c"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ustom preset removed), resume fails and the session becomes unusable. The dropdown's "修复失效模式会话" acti"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"on (and `repair` API) scans every session log and APPENDS a corrective `agent-preset/selected` event"},{"id":"p22s6","text":" pointing at the default preset (append-only; the last event wins on resume), skipping live sessions"},{"id":"p22s7","text":".
- **Unopened sessions too (auto-load)**: a session that is merely not loaded in this process is fi"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"rst resolved through the host Session controller (`resolveAgent()`, the same resolve-or-resume entry"},{"id":"p22s9","text":" behind `/api/session/*`) and recomposed live. Only when that fails (archived, unreadable, writer he"},{"id":"p22s10","text":"ld by another instance) does the plugin append a deferred selection event instead, applied on the ne"},{"id":"p22s11","text":"xt open.
- **Fenced route**: `POST /preset-switch/api` with `{ method: 'list' | 'switch' | 'repair',"},{"id":"p22s12","text":" sessionId, presetId, target? }` (Connection trust fence, same as dsh-sounds)."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### How it works"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The stock API (`agentPresets.select`) guards its swap with a blank-session check. This plugin calls "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"the same atomic primitive underneath — `agentPresets.recompose(agent.ctx, presetId)` — which re-link"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"s the agent's scope to the target preset's standing mount. The new composition is ensured before the"},{"id":"p24s4","text":" link moves, so a broken preset leaves the session untouched. On success the plugin appends the same"},{"id":"p24s5","text":" `agent-preset/selected` session event the proxy records, so projections and the header label follow"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"`agent-preset/selected` session event the proxy records, so projections and the header label follow."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"A not-loaded session has no live agent to recompose, so the plugin records the choice with the offic"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ial `sessionPersistence` handle API (`open(id,'write')` → `append` → `flush`). Resume composes from "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"the LAST `agent-preset/selected` event, so reopening the session applies the new mode. Reads always "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"use `open(id,'read')`, which never claims the single-writer slot of a live session."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Compatibility"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Targets **DSH 0.2.x** (adapted on 0.2.2-alpha.2):"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- host fence via the `connection` service's `requestRejection()` (the 0.1.x `webRuntime` service is "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"gone);
- session access via `sessionPersistence.open()`/`stat()`/`list()` (the old `inspect()`/`appe"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"nd()` are gone);
- switching a not-yet-loaded session goes through `sessionController.resolveAgent()"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"` (the host's resolve-or-resume entry);
- the client bundle is unchanged and still uses the `convers"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"ation.session.header.actions` slot."}],"truncated":true}
